paragraphs: They are mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, at the end of Shabbat, chapter 5, and in Beitzah, chapter 2, halakhah 8.[^1]

notes.text: The collective heading and verb are plural. The notice cites the end of Shabbat chapter5 and Beitzah chapter2, halakhah8. The inherited Jerusalem Talmud identification is inferred from the locator format, not independently checked against a named edition; end of chapter5 does not mean end of Shabbat as a whole.
